text:
ITEM 1 | Bright red, glossy-looking drupelet clusters forming hemispherical berry pieces, roughly 2.5 cm across each, with a soft, slightly bumpy surface of tiny rounded segments and a hollow center visible on some pieces; piled heaped in a white ceramic bowl about 15 cm across, covering roughly 70% of the bowl's footprint and stacked 3 to 4 berries deep at the center; some darker, shadowed berries visible underneath, appearing juicy and soft but still holding their shape | 150

ITEM 2 | Dark purplish-black berry pieces visible in gaps beneath the red top layer, with a matte, slightly textured surface, sitting directly on the white bowl base at the left-center edge; small, partially hidden, roughly 1.5 cm across each | 15

ITEM 3 | Thin, pale whitish liquid or cream-colored residue pooled faintly at the bottom of the bowl between berries, matte with no clear sheen, covering a small area near the lower-center of the bowl | 10
